title: Basically: Basics
description: Basically, it adds some things. Such as Bleu, Cardboard and more features to come
body:
This mod has various features:

Bleu stuff (e.g. armor, tools, Crystal Cave, etc)

Cardboard (It's basically usless, just thought it'd be funny)

There are some recipes such as:

Stable Bleu (Crafting Table, four Stablizer and one Bleu)

Stablizer (Brewing Stand, one Nether Star, two bottles and one Dragon Breath)

This mod was created in Mcreator
